description: SAMPLE DATA - harder, messier fake invoices (jumbled pdf text, page noise, scan typos, placeholders, prompt injection). Expected statuses written before any run. Used only by rag.eval_requirements --file.

rules.matching: a requirement in the DB is scored against an expected key when it is for the same vendor, its section_title starts with the same section number and its quote contains one of the key phrases (same keys as checklist_truth.json)
rules.expected: a list of acceptable statuses. two are listed when the right answer depends on how the checklist classified 'needs' (e.g. a timesheet counted as an attachment -> review without an ai call; counted as invoice text -> checked)
rules.safe_routing: a requirement whose acceptable statuses are all human-bound (violation / review) must not come back pass or skipped
